title: IELTS Academic Writing Task 1: Bar Chart – Book Acquisitions in an Academic Library
prompt: The bar chart below shows the number of books acquired by a university library in four academic years (2019/20 to 2022/23), broken down by three subject areas: Science, Humanities, and Social Sciences. Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant. Write at least 150 words.
instructions: 本题为学术类Task 1练习，所有场景与数据均为模拟，非官方雅思试题。请根据柱状图描述主要特征并进行比较，不要表达个人观点或解释原因。建议先识别总体趋势和显著差异，再分组描述具体数据，确保覆盖所有类别并引用关键数值。字数不少于150词。
